install_steps: Verify the downloaded DMG or ZIP against the release checksums.
Open the DMG and drag Cortex.app to Applications.
The app is Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple; it opens with a normal double-click.
Complete getting started by connecting a memory source, reviewing one memory, asking a cited question, then deciding on backup in Connections & Privacy.
known_limitations: Google, Notion, and Outlook managed OAuth sign-in require the founder to register the OAuth apps; email, Google, and GitHub sign-in work today.
Support starts from the sanitized support bundle, not raw memory folder data.
manual_qa_checklist: Install from the DMG on a clean macOS 13 or newer user profile.
Launch from Applications and complete first-run setup.
Connect a memory source in Connections & Privacy.
Approve at least one useful memory and archive obvious noise in Review.
Ask a question that returns cited memory from the approved connected source.
Verify Connections & Privacy shows memory folder path, backend health, backup, export, support bundle, and update feed controls.
Create a backup and confirm the support bundle contains no raw memory content.
Replace the app with this build over a previous build and confirm the memory folder remains intact.
Roll back to the previous build and confirm the memory folder remains intact.
rollback_steps: Keep the user's memory folder unchanged.
Replace Cortex.app in Applications with the previous beta build.
Relaunch, run the reliability report, and create a fresh backup.
update_steps: Quit Cortex before replacing the app.
Install the new Cortex.app over the old app in Applications.
Relaunch, confirm backend health, and run the reliability report.

release_notes: One-click connect, both ways: connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and Zed in a click, and bring your history in from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Notion.
Automatic updates: Cortex now checks for new builds on its own, so you stay current without re-downloading.
A cleaner, more intuitive app: dozens of UI refinements, Reduce Motion support, honest states everywhere, and Sign in with Apple in the restore flow.
Only-functional surfaces: every visible connection now leads to a real connection; nothing on screen is a dead end.
